headline: Denied variance to reduce side yard setback to 0 feet for porch enclosure at 28 Waterville St.
summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard a request for a Practical Difficulty Variance at 28 Waterville St to reduce the interior side yard setback from 5 feet to 0 feet, to enclose an existing covered porch. The Board voted 7-0 to deny the appeal.
decisions: Denied the Practical Difficulty Variance at 28 Waterville St to reduce the side yard setback from 5 feet to 0 feet, vote 7-0.

decision_evidence.quote: The Board voted 7-0 to deny the appeal.
